record:noun.en: The team set a new national record in the final.
record:noun.zh: 这支队伍在决赛中创造了新的全国纪录。

record:verb.en: Please record the temperature every thirty minutes.
record:verb.zh: 请每隔三十分钟记录一次温度。

present:noun-adjective.en: Everyone present received a small gift.
present:noun-adjective.zh: 每位在场的人都收到了一份小礼物。

present:verb.en: The researchers will present their findings on Friday.
present:verb.zh: 研究人员将在星期五公布他们的研究结果。

object:noun.en: A small metal object was lying beside the door.
object:noun.zh: 门旁边放着一个小金属物件。

object:verb.en: Residents object to the plan because it would increase traffic.
object:verb.zh: 居民反对这项计划，因为它会增加交通流量。

produce:noun.en: The market sells fresh produce from local farms.
produce:noun.zh: 这个市场出售当地农场的新鲜农产品。

produce:verb.en: These solar panels produce enough electricity for the school.
produce:verb.zh: 这些太阳能板产生的电力足够学校使用。

lead:metal.en: The old water pipes contained lead and had to be replaced.

lead:guide.en: A local guide will lead us through the forest.
lead:guide.zh: 一位当地向导将带领我们穿过森林。

read:present.en: I read the newspaper on the train every morning.
read:present.zh: 我每天早上在火车上读报纸。

read:past.en: She read the entire report before yesterday's meeting.
read:past.zh: 她在昨天的会议之前读完了整份报告。

content:noun.en: The course content includes both theory and practical work.
content:noun.zh: 课程内容包括理论和实践。

content:adjective.en: After a long walk, the dog seemed content to sleep by the fire.
content:adjective.zh: 长时间散步后，那只狗似乎很满足地睡在炉火旁。

desert:noun.en: Temperatures in the desert can fall sharply at night.
desert:noun.zh: 沙漠里的温度在夜间可能骤降。

desert:verb.en: They promised never to desert their friends in a crisis.
desert:verb.zh: 他们承诺绝不在危机中抛弃朋友。
